item.title: A Swiss helping of wellness at the Grand Resort Bad Ragaz
item.description: It’s not usual to step into a wellness resort and be greeted by a glass wall of fine wines bound for the largest number of Michelin-starred restaurants in one place. And it’s not typical to find a chef’s mouth-watering apple crumble waiting in your room as a welcome gift. But then, the Grand Resort Bad Ragaz is not a typical retreat. Here, wellness extends far beyond the spa embracing indulgence, pleasure and the art of slowing down in a luxurious setting, writes Jane Wilson.
